mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate environment compresses discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors shift from fixed income to equities.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 3.0% year-over-year triggers market anticipation of aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as bond yields rise and equity valuations contract.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales (HOUST and RSAFS) signal weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as recession risks escalate.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances (Rank IC < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%) signal reduced consumer spending power and corporate earnings pressure, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as recession risks materialize.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market growth (PAYEMS) consistently indicates robust corporate hiring and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as earnings expectations rise.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth is positive.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 100.0 signals manufacturing contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as recession fears intensify and corporate margins compress.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: Joint declines in GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate broad-based demand weakness, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as economic slowdown becomes evident.
failure_condition: The joint decline in GDPC1 and HOUST fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances (Rank IC < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: High inflation combined with tight monetary policy (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS > 2.0%) triggers aggressive rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as real rates rise and equity valuations contract.
regime_hint: high inflation and tight monetary policy
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS > 2.0%.
